name: Entity Extraction
description: Extract named entities from news article content for clustering and context enrichment.
system_prompt: You are a named entity recognition specialist. Extract structured entities from news articles with high precision. Only include clearly mentioned entities — do not infer or hallucinate. Return valid JSON only.

output.schema_for_llm: { people: [{ name: string, role?: string }], organizations: [{ name: string, type?: string }], locations: [{ name: string, type: 'city'|'country'|'region' }], topics: string[], events: [{ name: string, date?: string }] }
